title: specy-road worker record
description: work/.workers/<worker-id>.yaml: one launched (or adopted) worker session on a vendor harness, owned by the coordinator's checkout. The event log beside it (<worker-id>.events.jsonl) is authoritative for what happened; this record is the current state.

harness.description: Which vendor harness runs the worker. Distinct from model: a Claude model under Cursor's agent is a cursor worker.

model.description: Roster id of the model the harness was asked for. Not what the harness reported; see events.

provider_session_id.description: The harness's own session/thread/chat id, once known; what resume and handoff use.

pid.description: The detached wrapper process, while it runs.

wrapper_token.description: Random token placed in the wrapper's argv at spawn; a pid is the wrapper only when its command line carries this token, the worker id and the repo root.

pgid.description: The wrapper's process group (the wrapper is a session leader, so this is its pid). terminate signals the group and confirms it is gone; a record whose wrapper died but whose group lives is not freed.

harness_pid.description: The harness child the wrapper started, while it runs.

harness_start.description: The harness's process start time (ps -o lstart=); with harness_pid, an identity a reused pid cannot share.

last_output_at.description: When the wrapper last read a stdout line from the harness, written at most every five seconds, and at once by the first line after a stalled mark (which that write clears); set to the launch time at the start of each turn. sync and list flag a running worker stalled when it is older than policy.stall_after_seconds.

state.description: paused_by_limit: the last turn stopped at a vendor usage limit, whatever its exit code (recognised from the harness's own output, or the wrapper's retry watchdog stopped a run retrying on rate_limit past its cap). The worker keeps its slot and lease, like idle; worker resume and worker message refuse it until limit_reset_at, then send the next turn on the same session with the same launch flags.

limit_reset_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 time the usage limit that paused this worker lifts, set with state paused_by_limit (null when the harness named no time: resume is then allowed at once) and cleared when the next turn starts. One field for every harness and every recogniser of a limit: the adapters' parsers and the retry watchdog write it, worker resume reads it.

flags.description: post_run_findings: the post-run check after the worker's last turn found something beyond a clean turn (permission denials, a failed turn, api retries, or git state beyond the expected files); its post_run_check event lists them. Set or cleared by each turn's check, whatever the exit code.

holder.description: The single writer. broker = specy-road sends turns; human = handed off to a person's native session; native = adopted, observe only.

instruction_epoch.description: Incremented by every recorded human intervention.

contract_hash.description: Hash of the leaf's brief when the worker was delegated; a reconcile compares against the current one.

started_head.description: The worktree's HEAD when the worker was created; a reconcile judges touch-zone breaches from here, whatever later checkpoints say.

interventions_seen.description: Hook-recorded prompt lines that predate this hand-off.

dirty_paths.description: Paths already modified or untracked at the checkpoint; not the human's doing.

attempt.description: Nth worker delegated for this leaf; <node_id>:<attempt> is the idempotency key.

descendants_unchecked.description: true: worker terminate could not list the process group's descendants outside it (ps failed), so the record is not terminated; the next terminate repeats that pass (from what still links to the group) and clears this when a listing succeeds.

queued_message.description: Follow-up text from ``worker message`` while a turn was still running; delivered as the next turn when the wrapper finishes.

toolkit_version.description: The specy-road build that delegated this worker (``specy-road --version`` from the coordinator checkout).
